purpose: Construct a fresh animal-plant cohort matched on observation architecture before any ACSP candidate generation or held-out recovery is opened.

fresh_design.deterministic_candidate_rule: After exclusions, sort eligible species by coordinate_records then scientific_name; choose 8 approximately equally spaced rank positions across the available frame.

matching.distance: Euclidean across six scaled observation metrics
matching.selection: exact brute-force choice of two disjoint animal-plant pairs minimizing summed distance; deterministic lexicographic tie break

freeze_gate.if_fail: stop_without_acsp_outcome_opening; no threshold relaxation or candidate replacement
freeze_gate.if_pass: freeze cohort identities and authorize a separate post-merge ACSP confirmation contract

prohibited: use any ACSP recovery or lift outcome during cohort construction
inspect held-out occurrence recovery before cohort freeze
change the six observation metrics after viewing matching results
relax pair-distance or global-balance gates after matching
replace a failed region after the cohort result is known
use taxon ecology or expected ACSP performance as a matching criterion
